meta.title: docs: Performance improvements: Fix memory leaks, add HTTP timeouts, optimize UI rendering
meta.body_summary: Copilot addresses multiple performance issues: LRU cache for SVG network requests, HTTP timeouts, async file I/O, ListView.builder optimization, and adds a performance monitoring helper; includes documentation and unit test.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot fixed memory/timeout/rendering issues and added docs; maintainer requested lint but closure occurred without merge, likely due to incomplete validation environment.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 437 changed lines across 10 files, this is a small-to-medium refactor. It addresses multiple performance issues and adds new documentation and testing, but was closed without merge after maintainer lint request and agent's inability to run full Flutter analysis.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer teolemon asked Copilot to lint the files; Copilot could only perform partial validation due to firewall restrictions and could not run Flutter analyze.
review_details.performance_claim: Prevent OOM crashes via LRU cache, eliminate network hangs via timeouts, improve UI responsiveness via async I/O and ListView.builder, and add performance monitoring utility.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed after lint request without merge; no explicit rejection but lack of full validation likely contributed.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent PR performance improvement needed integration with the project's CI/lint environment; inability to run full Flutter analysis due to firewall restrictions hindered validation, leading to closure without merge.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiling; only narrative description of fixes and a performance monitoring helper added.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge after lint request; no fix-in-PR cycle.

core_change_summary.description: Implemented LRU cache for SVG network requests, added HTTP timeouts, converted synchronous file read to async, used ListView.builder for infinite scroll, and cached image provider computation to avoid rebuilds; added performance_helper.dart utility and unit test, plus PERFORMANCE.md doc.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: HTTP timeout changes are minimal (2 lines each) in location and newsfeed suppliers; documentation and test files are supportive.
change_trajectory: First commit: LRU cache in svg_safe_network.dart, HTTP timeouts in location and newsfeed, image provider caching in smooth_product_image.dart.
Second commit: async file operations in newsfeed_provider.dart, ListView.builder in infinite_scroll_list.dart, new performance_helper.dart and test.
